An '''Aleena child''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]] during the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
During the [[Mission to Aleen/Legends|Mission to Aleen]], this [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] welcomed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] into his village along with the rest of the villagers. After the troopers arrived, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolf]] sent a team of two troopers along with [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and a couple of Aleena, including this child, to repair and survey the local Republican communication station that was affected by an earthquake.<ref name="Mercy Mission (episode)" />

After the station was fixed, this village child along with two other Aleena showed R2-D2 and C-3PO a hole in the ground that led to the Aleena underworld, but a groundquake suddenly started and the two droids fell into the hole. An [[Unidentified Aleena 2/Legends|Aleena]] male then came back to the village to warm the remaining Aleena and the clones to come to their aide. Since the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] could not understand their language, [[King/Legends|King]] [[Manchucho/Legends|Manchucho]] returned with the rest of the villagers and started praying near the site where the two droids had fallen into the ground.<ref name="Mercy Mission (episode)" />

In the end, C-3PO and R2-D2 managed to return to the surface and this Aleena and the rest of the villagers celebrated when they sealed up the crack leading to the underworld. After the two droids departed, this child ran towards R2-D2 and hugged him before bidding farewell to both.<ref name="Mercy Mission (episode)" />
